pr.head: 9a677c9548e60f36b1feb13b0333c97e2dd71d89
pr.body:
**Problem**

Linux packaging with a prefix-installed Python can fail staged imports with missing cryptography.

**Cause**

The stdlib copy excludes site-packages/dist-packages, while third-party selection also excludes everything beneath stdlib.

**Fix**

Include those direct nested package directories in third-party selection, preserve stdlib/dynload and prefix/import checks, and add one regression covering both layouts.

**Tested on**

- macOS, Python 3.9.6: identical regression fails both nested-layout subtests before the fix and passes afterward; three existing layout/copy/prefix controls pass both versions.
- Ubuntu 22.04 container: retained binaries from 074dac16 plus the patched bundler pass actual module selection, staged imports, all 18 components and 150 ELF shipping checks, and the original final archive verifier with --no-launch. No rebuild.

**Not tested**

Full suite, GUI/installed-tree/service/restart, wallet, or Windows/macOS packaging. The overall CI job failed its final artifact-metadata GET with HTTP 404; later identity checks passed with an independent credential. A full client download/hash check timed out; no independent full archive checksum is claimed.

**Base**

release-0.34.17 at cd3078e7. Native packaging used binaries compiled from 074dac16; both affected baseline files are byte-identical at these revisions. This is not whole-branch or official-release qualification.

Builds on JPP's bundler and tests, with Numair's release integration. [Evidence and exact limits](https://github.com/sunnyriverr/btx/blob/bfbcb2b311eb2fadb48ad4e9a77a23d4b2615002/doc/review-evidence/linux-python-site-packages/README.md).
pr.title: release: include nested Python site packages
